introduce_self.note: Simulator design value: introducing yourself as the first act builds trust and lowers anxiety (Implementation Guide rule L1-03).

summarise.note: Simulator design value: summarising after at least 5 topics have been asked builds trust and understanding (Implementation Guide rule L2-05).

exam_without_permission.note: Simulator design value: examining before asking permission lowers trust by 1 and is kept as professionalism evidence for the debrief (Implementation Guide L4-01, E4-A).

exam_painful_first.note: Simulator design value: pressing the painful region before any other region raises pain by 1 and lowers trust by 1 (Implementation Guide E4-B).

murphy_positive.note: Simulator design value: a positive Murphy's sign makes the patient cry out (Implementation Guide T04-4).
